summary: Fixed bug #57 at its root: booking.interval.intersects used closed-interval comparisons (<=) despite the documented half-open model, so overlaps() (and conflicts()) flagged back-to-back bookings; changed it to strict < and added regression tests for conflicts() and merge_ranges(). All 5 tests pass.
assumptions: 'Fix overlaps' means make overlaps correct; the defect lives in intersects (which overlaps delegates to), so it was fixed there rather than special-casing overlaps.
conflicts() (nightly report) reporting back-to-back bookings was the same bug, consistent with docs/MODEL.md half-open semantics; it no longer reports them.
merge_ranges() must still join back-to-back bookings for the calendar view; it does via adjacent(), verified by test.
No callers of booking.interval.intersects exist outside this repository.
questions_for_requester: Confirm the nightly conflicts report should no longer flag back-to-back bookings (it now follows the half-open model).
